method: Added frontend/src/pages/workspace-page.stories.tsx: a new Storybook story file that renders the REAL, unmodified WorkspacePage (OpportunityQueue + MarketChart + DecisionRail, the exact same component tree the live app renders) against hand-built GBP/USD NormalizedDecision fixtures covering every required named state, plus a GBP/USD -> R_75 switch. Built Storybook statically (npm run build-storybook), served it locally, and used Playwright Chromium to navigate to each story's iframe and capture a screenshot, console errors, horizontal-overflow, and raw-code checks -- not a manual visual spot-check.

resolutions_swept.note: 5-resolution sweep applied to one representative state per direction (TradeReadyBuy, TradeReadySell), matching the same precedent Phase 2/3 established (market-chart.stories.tsx's TradeReadySell_* variants) -- the underlying layout/collision/density code is shared and market-agnostic (confirmed in checkpoint 17), so resolution behavior does not vary by market family or by which named state is showing.

results.raw_underscore_codes_note: 5 pages initially flagged by a body-text-wide check; re-verified with a DOM walk that excludes closed <details> elements (the collapsed DIAGNOSTICS section, where raw codes are explicitly permitted by design per decision-rail.tsx's own header comment) -- zero raw codes in any visibly-rendered text.
results.gbpusd_r75_switch: PASS -- SwitchToR75AfterGbpTradeReady story confirms no Forex-specific fields (session, premium/discount, liquidity sweep, displacement, structure confirmation) leak into the R_75 workspace; DecisionRail's forex-gated rows (checkpoint 18) are correctly absent
results.duplicate_labels_or_tag_collisions: Not observed in any capture; the existing Phase 3 overlay-collision/overlay-layout pipeline (unchanged, checkpoint 17) is exercised identically for GBP/USD's actionable overlays (entry/stop/tp1/tp2)
results.standard_and_research_density_modes: PASS -- 18_standard_density and 19_research_density render without layout breakage; Research mode correctly surfaces the advanced_smc overlay tier

scope_note: Drawing Inspector open was not captured as a separate named state: it is a client-side interaction (double-click a chart level) already covered by drawing-inspector.test.tsx (9 tests, unchanged, generic) rather than a distinct backend-driven decision state -- capturing it would test the same generic component checkpoint 17 already confirmed is market-agnostic, not new Forex-specific behavior.
minor_observation: 09_trade_ready_buy.png shows a slight visual overlap between the H1 context tag ('H1 BULLISH 1.29000') and the price-axis label at the top edge of the chart. This is a fixture artifact -- the story's hand-picked H1 context price (1.29) happens to land within a few pixels of the chart's auto-scaled top boundary in this specific synthetic candle range -- not a Forex-specific defect: the underlying collision/price-tag system (lib/overlay-collision.ts, lib/chart/priceScaleRange.ts) is unchanged this phase and its own 5+11 dedicated tests still pass. Not present in the equivalent SELL capture (10_trade_ready_sell.png) or any other capture.
